title: No response from pod
body:
AndroidAPS 3.1.0.3
Build: 1de236a602-2022.08.25-19:54
Remote: https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS
Flavor: fullrelease
Nightscout version: 14.2.2

I am on Omnipod Eros, Dexcom, and OrangeLink Pro. Android 12. Samsung Galaxy s22 Ultra

I got a "nonce resync" alert after a pod failed last week. 
I restarted everything- cleared caches, new pods, new batteries, restarted bluetooth. I searched the FB group for answers and saw that it might be the orangelink firmware. I updated it, still no response from pod. I sent in the orangelink for service repair. It came back as working 100%. Also got a second orangelink.

Tried to start a pod with new orangelink. No response from pod. I saw in the group that maybe, it will fix after downgrading the firmware on orangelink. No response from pod. Also just tried updating AndroidAps to 3.1, didn't work. 
Finally tried to install AndroidAps on a Galaxy tablet with android 12, still no response from pod.
